premises.evidence_span: But there's two options. Be treated like cattle or pay 5,000 euros.

premises.text: Wingly connects private pilots with passengers to share flight costs

premises.text: Wingly offers a platform that simplifies the booking process for flights
premises.evidence_span: On Wingly, you can book a flight in only a few clicks.

premises.text: Wingly Flight Request allows users to request flights from private pilots
premises.evidence_span: Today, we're super happy to be introducing live on this stage the Wingly Flight Request.

premises.text: Regulatory changes allow private pilots to share flight costs and advertise

premises.text: Wingly has developed a tailored insurance product for flights
premises.evidence_span: We developed a tailor-made insurance product that allow us to offer all our customers an extra 1 million euro coverage on all the flights you do.

premises.text: The private aviation market is worth over 35 billion euros with significant opportunities

premises.text: Many private planes remain unused, representing a significant opportunity for Wingly
premises.evidence_span: Private planes stay on the ground more than 70% of the time.

premises.text: Wingly can reduce flight costs for passengers significantly

premises.text: Wingly has experienced significant growth in community and flight offerings
